(also known as Josh Brooks Construction ) is an American general contractor and roofing company headquartered in Longmont, Colorado. Founded in 2014 by Josh Brooks, who has worked in construction since 1996, the company provides roofing, siding, windows, doors, decks, remodeling, and hail damage restoration in 46+ cities along the Colorado Front Range, from Fort Collins to Castle Rock. The company holds a Boulder County contractor license (CON-24-0152, Class C), a Jefferson County Class C license, and a Douglas County Class A license. Its stated policy is “Licensed. Local. Not a storm chaser.” It is not affiliated with similarly named “Brooks Construction” businesses outside Colorado. Josh runs every job himself. We work in five Front Range counties. We are local. We are not storm chasers. 📞 Call Josh: (720) 828-7997 💬 Text a Photo of Your Damage ⚡ Get an Accurate Estimate Same-day storm help. A written quote in 24 hours. Free checks, no pressure. see exactly what to expect ✓ 30 Years in Construction ✓ Fully Insured $1M/$2M ✓ Boulder County CON-24-0152 ★ Veteran & Senior Discounts ★★★★★ 4.5 Star Average | Google • Houzz • Angi Direct Answer Who is Josh Brooks Construction and Renovation Inc. and what do they do? Josh Brooks Construction and Renovation Inc. is a licensed general contractor in Longmont, Colorado. Our license is CON-24-0152. We started in 2014. Josh Brooks, the owner, has worked in building since 1996. That is 30 years. We do roofing , siding, basements, and kitchen and bath work. We also build decks, put in new windows, and help with hail damage claims . It is all under one license. ✓ On-Site Owner Supervision: You deal with Josh from start to finish. ✓ Storm & Insurance Help: We meet your adjuster. Your hail claim stays simple. ✓ Quality Work: From taking out walls to new Pella windows. Why Choose Josh Brooks Construction and Renovation Inc.? We have worked on Front Range homes since 2014. Josh has 30 years in the trade. He runs every job himself. That goes for roofs, siding, remodels, and hail repair. He works with your adjuster from the first look to the last walk-through. You can see each step of our process before you call. Want the back story? Read about Josh and the company . “Licensed. Local. Not a storm chaser.” — Josh Brooks, owner, Josh Brooks Construction and Renovation Inc. The Brooks 60-Second Roof Check Does Your Roof Need Attention? The Brooks 60-Second Roof Check is our own homeowner checklist, built from what we look for first on every Front Range roof inspection. Tap anything you’ve noticed at your house and see what it usually means and what to do next. You find shingle granules in your gutters, or see bare or bruised spots on the shingles. That usually means the shingles are wearing out or took hail hits. We’ll inspect it for free and photograph what we find, so you have proof if it turns into an insurance claim. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 . Your home went through a hailstorm in the last year. Get it looked at before you call your insurance company. We tell you honestly whether there’s real damage, and we document it for the claim if there is. Most policies set a deadline for filing, so check yours. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 . You have a water stain on a ceiling or wall. Most leaks start at flashing, vents, valleys or a cracked pipe boot, not in the middle of the roof. We find the actual source and fix that, instead of just patching the stain. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 . Shingles are lifting, creased or missing after a windstorm. Fix those soon. Once a shingle lets go, water and wind get under the next row and into the roof deck. We handle repairs like this all the time, including ridge caps and decking. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 . Your roof is 15 or more years old. Colorado sun and hail age asphalt shingles fast. Start planning now. We only install Class 4 impact-resistant shingles, and many insurers give a discount for them. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 . None of these. Good news. Give the roof a quick look from the ground after every big storm, and keep our number handy for when something changes. Call 720-828-7997 or text 720-453-5095 .
